symbols.name: NotifierBuilder
symbols.summary: Configures and builds the Notifier service for dependency injection registration.
symbols.remarks: This class provides a fluent API for registering handlers, behaviors, and providers for the Notifier system. It scans assemblies for handlers and validators, caches handler types in a shared BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.IHandlerCache, and registers services with the DI container. Uses BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.HandlerCacheFactory to ensure a single shared cache.

symbols.name: AddHandlers(IEnumerable)
symbols.summary: Scans assemblies to register notification handlers, validators, and providers, excluding those matching blacklist patterns. Populates the shared BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.IHandlerCache with handler mappings and registers handlers in the DI container.
symbols.remarks: Discovers types implementing BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.INotificationHandler%601 where TNotification implements BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.INotification directly or indirectly, including domain-event notification types. Also registers nested validators if they implement FluentValidation.IValidator%601 for the notification type.

parameters.description: Optional regex patterns to exclude assemblies (e.g., "^System\\..*"). Defaults to BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.Blacklists.ApplicationDependencies.

returns.description: The BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.NotifierBuilder instance for fluent chaining.
